title: wb init --apply renders a roster README the prettier gate refuses
body: Found in the 3.3.0 estate sweep (ST0092 WP-11), 2026-11-11. The README that intent wb init --apply renders is not prettier-formatted, so a project whose pre-commit gate checks markdown formatting refuses the commit until prettier --write is run on it by hand. Every board converged in the sweep needed that step. The render should come out already formatted, as every other generated view does.
